objective: Implement Modules 1, 4, 5: write builder-control/agent-registry.json (governance only, infraRef pointers, no runtime fields), and build builder-control/gate.cjs — the HARD-BLOCK permission gate that loads the registry + a task packet + protected-paths.json, decides PASS/BLOCK per the RULE-ID set in CONTROL-CONTRACT.md s6, and shells the existing drift scripts (check-drift.cjs, audit-protocol-content-contract.mjs, protocol-drafter-guard.js, validateBrain) using their exit codes.
constraints: REUSE > REBUILD: gate.cjs SHELLS the existing drift scripts; it must NOT reimplement tier-matrix/SKU/content-contract/brain logic.

agent-registry.json MUST validate against builder-control/schemas/agent-registry.schema.json and MUST NOT contain agentId/environmentId/memstoreId/cron/runtimeType (those resolve via infraRef to managed-agents-registry.json).
HARD-BLOCK from day one: unauthorized write/commit/push/release => process.exit(non-zero) and refuse. No write happens on block.
Block message MUST follow the fixed format in s6 (rule, agentId, operation, reason, packetId, override line). False positives must be debuggable.
The ONLY override is a task packet authorization{} block. No --force, no skip env-var, no silent bypass anywhere.
BC-FORBIDDEN-TASK / BC-INVENTED-AUTHORITY / BC-DOSING-OUT-OF-CANON / BC-GOV-AUTHORITY-LEAK are NOT packet-overridable.
Do not edit any protected-paths.json entry; gate.cjs and packets/** are in claude-code allowedPathGlobs so writing them is permitted.
Anti-theater: report done only with files changed + commands run + exit codes in the same response.
